title: Panini: Continual Learning in Token Space via Structured Memory
authors: Shreyas Rajesh; Pavan Holur; Mehmet Yigit Turali; Chenda Duan; Vwani Roychowdhury
why_relevant: Panini explicitly targets reliability issues in RAG: it reduces unsupported/hallucinated generation from irrelevant chunk context and evaluates abstention on unanswerable queries via curated splits.
why_not_or_caveat: Primarily a structured-memory/efficiency method; robustness/abstention is a secondary contribution rather than the central focus.
